description: Search the Nightbreak wiki for relevant pages and snippets. Matching is by word and case-insensitive, ranked by title, page name and body. Each result has a `page` value to pass to fetch_wiki_page. Use for high-level docs, examples, and tutorials — not for symbol verification (use search_plugin_source for that).

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return. Defaults to 10.

query.description: Keywords to search for, such as "lua power files", "creating bosses", or "elitescript bridge".

name: search_wiki
